newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Comments made by Russia's Lebed after sacking.
newsitem.headline: Comments made by Russia's Lebed after sacking.

text.p: Here are some of the remarks made by Alexander Lebed at a news conference on Thursday hours after President Boris Yeltsin sacked him as the secretary of his policy making Security Council and national security adviser.
- On the reasons for his sacking:
"I was an obstacle to plans by (Yeltsin chief of staff Anatoly) Chubais to set up a regency. He wants to become president."
"The main reason is that two days ago I sent to the president results of my investigation into who was to blame for (conflict in breakaway) Chechnya."
- On relations with other Kremlin officials:
"I was a black sheep in the herd. It was only a matter of time before they sacked me. I am not part of their herd."
"Firstly I plan to have a good sleep. Then I will start adjusting (my) political machine to be ready for the presidential election."
"I am not going to launch a pre-election campaign while the president is alive."
- An appeal to his voters and allies:
"I call on my comrades in arms, my allies and people who I probably do not know in person...do not do anything abrupt. We act only using constitutional means."
"We are heading for a very hot autumn, no doubt about it."
- On his family's reaction to his sacking:
"My dog was indifferent. My wife is busy answering phone calls of support. So she keeps writing notes for me: 'This is not the end of the world, this is not the end of the world...'"
